name: api-contract-guardian
description: Maintains strict API contract integrity between client and server. Generates OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, detects type drift between frontend and backend, and provides instant zero-dependency mock API servers.
suggestedPrompts: Generate an OpenAPI 3.1 specification from my backend route definitions and schemas
Detect type drift between my frontend TypeScript interfaces and backend API response payloads
Spin up a local mock server based on my OpenAPI spec so frontend development can proceed
